name: Lemony Grain Bowl with Green Beans, Chickpeas, and Cottage Cheese

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, divided, plus more for drizzling
fresh dill, divided, plus more for serving
ground sumac, plus more for serving
cooked grains, warm or room temperature

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate the zest from the lemon. Juice the lemons. Finely grate the garlic. Pick the dill fronds from the stems and chop them. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp lemon zest
2 lemons, divided
2 medium cloves garlic, divided
5 tsp fresh dill, divided, plus more for serving
1 (15 oz) can chickpeas

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons lemon juice, honey, Dijon, 1 grated garlic clove, and 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt. Slowly drizzle in 4 tablespoons oil, whisking constantly, until emulsified; set aside.

In a medium bowl, whisk together cottage cheese, black pepper, 2 teaspoons dill, lemon zest, and 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, remaining grated garlic clove, and 3 tablespoons oil until curds are almost smooth and slightly fluffy, about 1 minute; set aside.

In a large stainless steel skillet, heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil over high until almost smoking. Add green beans and cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and charred, about 4 minutes. Off heat, season with 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and sumac. Toss to evenly coat.
In a medium bowl, stir chickpeas, 3 tablespoons prepared lemon dressing, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, remaining 2 tablespoons lemon juice, and remaining 1 tablespoon dill until well coated.
Add grains to large bowl with remaining dressing and toss until evenly coated. Season with remaining 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt.

Divide grains evenly among 4 bowls. Top evenly with green beans and chickpeas. Dollop cottage cheese mixture over top. Drizzle with more olive oil, to taste. Top with dill, sumac, and pickled red onions, if using.

stand_ins: cooked grains, warm or room temperature

schema_metadata.keywords: grain bowl, chickpea grain bowl, spring grain bowl

description: This bright, lemony dinner layers grains, chickpeas, charred green beans, and whipped cottage cheese for a balanced, flavorful meal.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Pickled red onions, for serving (optional)

Make-ahead and storage: Lemon dressing and charred green beans can be made up to 4 days in advance. Refrigerate them in separate airtight containers.
Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
